subject: general
question: The average of 41 numbers is 62. The average of the first 18 numbers is 65.5 and the average of the last 24 numbers is 61.5. If the 18th number from the beginning is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
solution:
Given:

The average of the 41 number = 62

Formula used:

Average = (The sum of all the items)/(The total number of items)

Calculation:

Let us assume the average of the remaining numbers be X

The total sum of 41 numbers = 41 × 62 = 2542

The total sum of the first 18 numbers = 18 × 65.5 = 1179

The total sum of last 24 numbers = 24 × 61.5 = 1476

The 18st number = 1179 + 1476 - 2542 = 113

When 18st number is removed then total sum = 2542 - 113 = 2429

The required average = 2429/40 = 60.725

∴ The required result will be 60.725.
